events.title: Surf Air Mobility Inc. (SRFM) Stock Price, News, Quote & History
events.summary: This article provides a detailed financial overview of Surf Air Mobility Inc. (SRFM), including its stock price, historical performance, key financial metrics, and analyst insights. As of October 1, 2026, SRFM was trading at $1.1850, down 1.26%, with a market capitalization of $157.426 million. The company, founded in 2011, operates an air mobility platform offering scheduled commercial and on-demand flights.

articles.headline: Surf Air Mobility Inc. (SRFM) Stock Price, News, Quote & History

events.title: Venture Global jumps on ConocoPhillips LNG supply deal
events.summary: Venture Global's shares climbed 3% after announcing a 20-year liquefied natural gas supply agreement with ConocoPhillips. Under the agreement, ConocoPhillips will purchase 1.0 million tonnes per annum of LNG from Venture Global starting in 2030, significantly expanding Venture Global's customer base and future supply commitments. Venture Global is a major U.S. LNG exporter with over 100 million tonnes per annum of capacity in various stages of development.

articles.headline: Venture Global jumps on ConocoPhillips LNG supply deal

events.title: Rising yields are reflecting better growth, says Morgan Stanley's Daniel Skelly
events.summary: Daniel Skelly, managing director at Morgan Stanley Wealth Management, appeared on 'Closing Bell Overtime' to discuss current market dynamics. He stated that rising yields in the market are indicative of better growth prospects. The discussion also covered the bond market and broader market actions.

articles.headline: Rising yields are reflecting better growth, says Morgan Stanley's Daniel Skelly

events.title: Federal Realty acquires Alabama shopping center for $508 million
events.summary: Federal Realty Investment Trust has acquired The Summit shopping center in Birmingham, Alabama, for $508 million. This marks the first sale of the 100-acre, 870,000-square-foot open-air retail property, which boasts over 110 tenants and draws nearly 9 million annual visits. Federal Realty plans to fund the acquisition through a combination of asset sales, free cash flow, and convertible notes, expanding its Central Region portfolio.

articles.headline: Federal Realty Acquires The Summit, Alabama's Premier Retail Destination

events.title: September 2026 Recap | On The Margin
events.summary: The "September 2026 Recap | On The Margin" report from CBIZ details that global markets experienced mostly negative returns in September 2026, primarily due to inflation concerns and rising interest rates impacting equities and fixed income. While U.S. large-cap growth stocks were an exception, small-cap stocks, international equities, and bonds all saw declines. The full publication is available for download, offering detailed insights into these market trends.

events.title: How Is Record Production Propelling Canadian Natural Resources Limited (TSX:CNQ) To New Heights?
events.summary: Canadian Natural Resources Limited (TSX:CNQ) has achieved record quarterly production, driven by operational excellence and strategic acquisitions, particularly in the Peace River region. This led to unprecedented adjusted net earnings and sustained its multi-decade dividend growth streak. The company's strategic priorities include maximizing production, disciplined spending, and shareholder distributions, while also addressing climate transition initiatives.

articles.headline: How Is Record Production Propelling Canadian Natural Resources Limited (TSX:CNQ) To New Heights?

events.title: Lam Research Corp Stock (LRCX) Moved Up by 3.01% on Oct 1: Key Drivers Unveiled
events.summary: Lam Research Corp (LRCX) stock rose by 3.01% due to optimism surrounding memory capital expenditures and favorable industry tailwinds, including aggressive spending plans from major memory chip manufacturers and positive analyst upgrades. The company, a dominant supplier of semiconductor equipment, is benefiting from strong demand driven by artificial intelligence infrastructure. Despite some intraday volatility and macroeconomic uncertainties, the medium-term outlook is positive, supported by structural AI hardware demand and high-margin tool utilization.

articles.headline: Lam Research Corp Stock (LRCX) Moved Up by 3.01% on Oct 1: Key Drivers Unveiled

events.title: Phillips 66 Adds ~$4 Billion in Market Value in a Single Session
events.summary: Phillips 66 (PSX) saw a significant increase in market value, adding approximately $4 billion in a single session. The stock closed up 4.1% at $263.64, a rare and substantial move for a large-cap refiner. This strong performance, which held throughout the day, suggests potential continued interest from traders and long-term investors.

articles.headline: Phillips 66 Adds ~$4 Billion in Market Value in a Single Session

events.title: Analog Semiconductors Stocks Q2 Recap: Benchmarking Analog Devices (NASDAQ:ADI)
events.summary: This article provides a Q2 recap for analog semiconductor stocks, focusing on Analog Devices (NASDAQ:ADI) and its strong performance, exceeding revenue and operating income expectations. It also highlights Monolithic Power Systems (NASDAQ:MPWR) as a top performer with significant revenue growth and Himax (NASDAQ:HIMX) as the slowest, despite still exceeding analyst expectations. The report briefly touches on market uncertainties like AI and geopolitics, emphasizing the importance of solid fundamentals for investment.

articles.headline: Analog Semiconductors Stocks Q2 Recap: Benchmarking Analog Devices (NASDAQ:ADI)

events.title: NextEra Energy Eyes 18 GW Gas Opportunity, Targets Dominion Deal Growth
events.summary: NextEra Energy is making significant strides in its growth strategy, identifying 18 GW of gas opportunities, including 16 GW linked to federal hubs and a 4.6 GW project at Paducah. The company is also expanding its data-center and large-load strategy in Florida and progressing with the proposed combination of Dominion operations in Virginia and the Carolinas. This deal is projected to expand the combined company's capacity from 110 GW to approximately 240 GW by 2032, with an adjusted EPS growth exceeding 9%.

articles.headline: NextEra Energy Eyes 18 GW Gas Opportunity, Targets Dominion Deal Growth

events.title: Phillips 66 Stock (PSX) Moved Up by 3.11% on Oct 1: What Signal Does It Send?
events.summary: Phillips 66 (PSX) stock increased by 3.11% on October 1st, outperforming the Energy - Fossil Fuels sector. This surge is attributed to favorable Wall Street rating adjustments, institutional accumulation, and strong quarterly earnings driven by elevated crack spreads and refinery utilization. The company's expanded share repurchase program and competitive dividend strategy are also contributing factors to investor confidence.

articles.headline: Phillips 66 Stock (PSX) Moved Up by 3.11% on Oct 1: What Signal Does It Send?

events.title: Constellation vs Vistra stock: PJM delay puts contracts first
events.summary: The Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) has accepted PJM's reliability-backstop framework but suspended its effectiveness for five months, impacting new capacity procurement rather than existing bilateral contracts. This article compares Constellation Energy (CEG) and Vistra (VST) focusing on their AI-linked power contracts, highlighting that Vistra has more operating megawatts under contract while Constellation's Microsoft deal depends on a plant restart. For investors, Vistra offers a clearer setup with existing generating assets, whereas Constellation's investment case is more reliant on the successful restart of its Crane plant in 2027.

articles.headline: Constellation vs Vistra stock: PJM delay puts contracts first

events.title: MSTR Stock Outlook as Strategy CEO Questions MSCI’s Anti-Bitcoin Stance Ahead of November Rebalancing
events.summary: MSTR stock is rising following softer US inflation data, but faces potential removal from the MSCI index in November due to MSCI's proposed classification changes. Strategy's CEO, Phong Le, and Strive's CEO, Matt Cole, have criticized MSCI's stance, calling it anti-Bitcoin, especially given MSCI CEO Henry Fernandez's push for a "green" benchmark. Meanwhile, Strategy's STRC stock is nearing its par value due to proposed daily dividends, and MSTR stock needs to close above its 200-week EMA to confirm an upward trend.

articles.headline: MSTR Stock Outlook as Strategy CEO Questions MSCI’s Anti-Bitcoin Stance Ahead of November Rebalancing

events.title: Why Deere (DE) Stock Is Down Today
events.summary: Deere & Company (DE) stock is down 3.2% today, primarily attributed to broad market pressure on industrial stocks and profit-taking after its strong late-August rally. Despite a strong third-quarter earnings report, investors appear to be rotating out of economically sensitive names as Treasury yields climb. Insider trading shows significant sales by an executive, while institutional investors have both increased and decreased their positions, and members of Congress have made one sale.

articles.headline: Why Deere (DE) Stock Is Down Today

events.title: National Fuel Gas Company completed the acquisition of Vectren Energy Delivery of Ohio, LLC from CenterPoint Energy Resources Corp.
events.summary: National Fuel Gas Company announced the completion of its acquisition of Vectren Energy Delivery of Ohio, LLC from CenterPoint Energy Resources Corp. for $2.6 billion. The newly acquired utility will be renamed National Fuel Gas Distribution of Ohio, LLC, and approximately 200 employees will join National Fuel as part of the transaction. The acquisition, which was previously approved by the Public Utilities Commission of Ohio, is expected to be immediately accretive to National Fuel's regulated earnings per share.

articles.headline: National Fuel Gas Company completed the acquisition of Vectren Energy Delivery of Ohio, LLC from CenterPoint Energy Resources Corp.

events.title: Microchip completes Hailo deal as Microchip Technology stock trades at EUR 68.89
events.summary: Microchip Technology has completed its acquisition of Hailo, integrating edge AI processors, vision processors, robotics processors, and AI software into its portfolio. The deal, which adds over 100 customers and a developer community of 10,000, is strategically significant despite a limited near-term earnings impact. The announcement comes as Microchip reported strong first-quarter fiscal 2027 revenue of USD 1.48 billion, up 38% year-over-year, and while its stock trades below its 52-week high.

articles.headline: Microchip completes Hailo deal as Microchip Technology stock trades at EUR 68.89

events.title: CMA CGM Group completes acquisition of FedEx Supply Chain, strengthening its logistics presence in North America, and enters into multi-year commercial agreements related to air and ocean freight
events.summary: The CMA CGM Group has completed its $1.4 billion acquisition of FedEx Supply Chain, significantly expanding CEVA Logistics' North American contract logistics operations. This acquisition nearly triples CEVA's footprint, adding 34 million square feet of warehouse space and approximately 10,000 team members. Concurrently, CMA CGM and FedEx have entered into multi-year commercial agreements for air and ocean freight, enhancing their global networks and logistical capabilities.

articles.headline: CMA CGM Group completes acquisition of FedEx Supply Chain, strengthening its logistics presence in North America, and enters into multi-year commercial agreements related to air and ocean freight

events.title: U.S. Bank and DAT: Contract and spot truck freight rates diverge
events.summary: The latest quarterly U.S. Bank Freight Payment Index – Rates Edition, produced in collaboration with DAT Freight & Analytics, indicates a divergence in contract and spot truck freight rates between June and August. Contract rates increased, while spot rates decreased, leading to contract rates carrying a premium over spot freight by August. Fuel costs also significantly impacted total transportation spending, increasing even as spot linehaul pricing softened.

articles.headline: U.S. Bank and DAT: Contract and spot truck freight rates diverge

events.title: ConocoPhillips Weighs Selling Its Norway Business
events.summary: ConocoPhillips is considering an unsolicited offer to sell its Norway business and the Teesside oil terminal in the UK, as Brent crude approaches $100 a barrel. This move is part of the typical portfolio reshuffling by major oil companies to fund higher-return projects or shareholder payouts. A potential sale would provide a real-time valuation for these assets, allowing analysts to re-evaluate the company's sum-of-the-parts valuation and influence stock performance.

articles.headline: ConocoPhillips says weighing sale of Norway business, U.K. Teesside asset (COP:NYSE)
ConocoPhillips Weighs Selling Its Norway Business

events.title: ONEOK Stock: Second Guidance Raise And Brazos Deal Make The Pullback Compelling (NYSE:OKE)
events.summary: ONEOK (OKE) has raised its full-year guidance for the second time in 2026, fueled by strong Q2 results and a $4.425 billion acquisition of Brazos Midstream. Despite improved fundamentals, OKE's forward valuation has compressed to 14.75x EPS, with adjusted EBITDA guidance now at $8.35 billion and EPS at $5.68 for 2026. The company's growth is supported by nearing project completions, a positive macro environment, and an efficient acquisition structure, making its 4.93% forward dividend yield and robust free cash flow coverage compelling.

articles.headline: ONEOK Stock: Second Guidance Raise And Brazos Deal Make The Pullback Compelling (NYSE:OKE)
